g.text: 6 · How a runtime request uses TPM quota
Claude 3.7 and later on bedrock-runtime: output burns 5×, max_tokens is reserved up front
Throttling comes from the reservation, not the bill
A large max_tokens holds quota you never use, so 429s arrive early.
Set max_tokens close to the output you expect.
Runtime has one TPM quota per model covering input and output; there's no RPM limit. Mantle meters input and output separately.
